finding: Temporal proximity plus a caller-supplied session identifier does not establish that retained capability and hostname command transcripts participated in the asserted bounded session.

primary_current.observed_fact: Node exposes cryptographic random generation primitives including randomBytes and randomUUID.
UUID version 4 is based on random or pseudorandom bits, suitable as one possible challenge identifier when generated correctly.

contract: challenge nonce must be syntactically valid and issued before capability observation
both retained raw transcripts must contain the exact challenge nonce
each transcript must bind the corresponding child receipt digest
each raw transcript digest must verify
the parent receipt binds both transcript digests, both child receipt digests, session receipt, deployment identity, hostname, and expected commit

evidence_strength: committed implementation and deterministic tests; runtime execution not observed in this connector-only run
uncertainty: A transcript containing a nonce can still be fabricated after the fact unless acquisition is performed by a trusted runner or independently timestamped retention system.
This contract does not prove both commands used the same process or curl binary.
No real Vercel hostname request or provider deployment retrieval was performed.
claim_boundary: Verifies challenge presence, raw transcript integrity, and child-receipt binding only; does not claim same process, same executable, content correctness, alias behavior, audio, browser behavior, or physical-device behavior.
falsification_route: A challenge issued after capability observation is accepted.
A transcript lacking the nonce is accepted.
A transcript bound to a different child receipt is accepted.
A raw transcript can change without invalidating its digest or parent receipt.
specialist_registry_change: none; no durable capability gap demonstrated
